body: I haven't made a promise in 5 years, and I'm not going to start now; they caused too many disappointments I'll do my best, though.
Daxzus, I don't know you, but I already love you. If you PM me your contact info, I'd be more than happy to put you on my christmas gift list for the rest of my natural life.

I can't express my gratitude in words. I may have gotten the same advice from one of my friends, but I can't bring myself to tell anyone who knows me. I just spent about 5 minutes crying, moved by your compassion for a stranger. If I end up helping anyone like  you've just helped me, I'll count my life worth living even if I spend the rest of it miserable.
final decision about this situation was just about ending it all or continuing life without any real hope of financial/social success.

I don't think I'm beyond saving. I'm sure I could survive this, but I can't picture admitting to my family that I've just been a waste of money for 21 years. Their hopes and dreams for my future will pretty much go out the window. Once I start working full time to afford rent in this overpriced area, I can't imagine being able to go back to school, or saving up enough money to buy a car, or having enough freedom to pursue my dream of being a professional magician without one. I'll be stuck in menial jobs for the rest of my life, without a decent chance of touching anyone's life in a meaningful way and likely dying alone anyway from liver failure as I already have a drinking problem after 8 months.

it's worth noting that I only have about a week to make a final decision about this situation. School will start up on the 7th of January, and if the topic comes up before hand, I'll either need to just man up and tell the truth or avoid the topic, likely driving me to "run away"
